caption: This model rebuilds the famous time-travel sequence from Back to the Future where the DeLorean hits 88 mph. The scale model features a gleaming stainless-steel finish and a period-accurate 1985 interior, capturing the exact moment of temporal displacement. It’s fascinating how quickly the 'future' can become a bit dusty.
